info.title: Online Food Ordering & Restaurant Management System API
info.description: REST API for a multi-role food ordering platform (Customer, Restaurant Owner, Delivery Partner, Admin). See /docs in this repo for the database schema, ER diagram, and a Postman collection.

get.summary: Get a user profile (self or admin)

patch.summary: Update a user profile (self or admin)

post.summary: Add an address to the current user's address book

patch.summary: Update an address in the current user's address book

delete.summary: Remove an address from the current user's address book

patch.summary: Upload/replace the current user's profile picture

get.summary: List reviews for a restaurant
Search restaurants (text search, cuisine/city/isOpen filters, sorting, pagination, geo-radius)
List restaurants owned by the current user, including unapproved ones (dashboard use)
Get restaurant details

patch.summary: Update a restaurant (owner/admin)

get.summary: Browse a restaurant's menu grouped by category

patch.summary: Upload restaurant logo/cover image (owner/admin)

get.summary: Restaurant owner dashboard statistics (owner/admin)
Get a payment record (order owner or admin)

post.summary: Verify a completed Razorpay checkout and mark the payment paid
Place an order from the customer's active cart (checkout)

get.summary: List orders scoped to the caller's role (customer/restaurantOwner/deliveryPartner see their own; admin sees all)
Get order details and status history (for tracking)

patch.summary: Update order status (restaurantOwner confirms/prepares/marks ready/cancels; admin can force any transition)

get.summary: List the current user's notifications, newest first (includes unreadCount in meta)

patch.summary: Mark a single notification as read
Mark every notification for the current user as read

get.summary: Search/filter menu items across restaurants (name/description search, veg, price range, sorting, pagination)
Get a menu item

patch.summary: Update a menu item (owner/admin)
Upload a menu item image (owner/admin)

get.summary: Liveness/readiness probe
Get the delivery partner's own profile

patch.summary: Update vehicle/profile details
Toggle availability to receive new deliveries
Update the delivery partner's live location

get.summary: List unassigned orders ready for pickup
List orders currently assigned to this delivery partner
List this delivery partner's completed/cancelled deliveries

patch.summary: Accept (self-assign) a ready-for-pickup order
Mark an assigned order as picked up from the restaurant
Mark a picked-up order as out for delivery
Mark an order as delivered (also settles a pending Cash on Delivery payment)

get.summary: List categories for a restaurant

patch.summary: Update a menu category (owner/admin)

delete.summary: Delete a menu category — fails if it still has menu items (owner/admin)

get.summary: Get the current customer's active cart

post.summary: Add an item to the cart (replaces cart if switching restaurants)

patch.summary: Update a cart item's quantity

delete.summary: Remove an item from the cart

post.summary: Register a new user (customer, restaurantOwner, or deliveryPartner)
Log in with email and password
Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token

get.summary: Get the current authenticated user's profile

post.summary: Create the first admin account, or promote an existing account to admin (secret-gated)
post.description: Disabled unless ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET is set on the server. Exists so an admin account can be created on platforms without shell access (e.g. a Render web service) without exposing admin as a public self-registration role.

get.summary: Platform-wide analytics (users by role, restaurant approvals, orders by status, revenue)
List all users (search by name/email, filter by role, paginate/sort)

patch.summary: Activate or deactivate a user (customer, restaurantOwner, or deliveryPartner)

get.summary: List all restaurants including unapproved ones

patch.summary: Approve or revoke approval for a restaurant to go live

get.summary: List all delivery partner profiles
